Author: Ignes
Name: Copy Glamour
Description:
Reads the gear and dyes from an Eorzea Collection glamour page (copied with Ctrl+A, Ctrl+C, or saved with Ctrl+S) and applies them to your character with Glamourer.
Pick which pieces to apply, save the result as a Glamourer design, and see where to get each piece: vendors with their location, currency shops and crafting.
Requires Glamourer.
Punchline: Copy an Eorzea Collection glamour page and wear it through Glamourer.
